entries.title: Jeremiah 47:1
segments: ¶The word of the Lord which came to Jeremiah the prophet about the Philistines, before Pharaoh's attack on Gaza.

entries.title: Jeremiah 47:2
segments: This is what the Lord has said: See, waters are coming up out of the north, and will become an overflowing stream, overflowing the land and everything in it, the town and those who are living in it; and men will give a cry, and all the people of the land will be crying out in pain.

entries.title: Jeremiah 47:3
segments: At the noise of the stamping of the feet of his war-horses, at the rushing of his carriages and the thunder of his wheels, fathers will give no thought to their children, because their hands are feeble;

entries.title: Jeremiah 47:4
segments: Because of the day which is coming with destruction on all the Philistines, cutting off from Tyre and Zidon the last of their helpers: for the Lord will send destruction on the Philistines, the rest of the sea-land of Caphtor.

entries.title: Jeremiah 47:5
segments: The hair is cut off from the head of Gaza; Ashkelon has come to nothing; the last of the Anakim are deeply wounding themselves.

entries.title: Jeremiah 47:6
segments: O sword of the Lord, how long will you have no rest? put yourself back into your cover; be at peace, be quiet.

entries.title: Jeremiah 47:7
segments: How is it possible for it to be quiet, seeing that the Lord has given it orders? against Ashkelon and against the sea-land he has given it directions.
